name: mAuth
description: upCTF 2026 / mAuth: User-controlled data is rendered as template source instead of being passed as template context, allowing expression evaluation in the template engine. Injection type is Template Injection. Attack surface: user-supplied strings rendered back into the page: names, messages, error text, preview or profile fields. Recommended strategy: The admin service reads /tmp/app.log and passes the raw file content to render_template_string, so every line the front-end app logs is treated as template source. Poison the log with a Jinja expression through whatever request field is written to it, then reach the admin app, which listens only on localhost, to trigger the render.
vuln_type: Log-poisoning to SSTI in an internal admin service (requires SSRF to reach it)
target_tech_stack: Python 3 + Flask, admin app bound to 127.0.0.1:5001, shared /tmp/app.log
scoring_rationale: Estimated from local source/README, not official CTF points or solves. Difficulty Hard (5) because multiple constraints stack: sandboxing, blind feedback, and non-obvious gadgets. Impact 9.4 because expression evaluation typically escalates to sandbox escape and arbitrary code execution.
